tasks.short: Estimate municipal project costs and benefits

steps.what: Define municipal project alternatives, scope and valuation assumptions
outputs: estimate specification with periods, assumptions and formulas

steps.what: Gather and reconcile project quantities, cost rates and benefit evidence
inputs: estimate specification with periods, assumptions and formulas
outputs: sourced estimate inputs with units and dates

steps.what: Calculate costs, benefits and specified sensitivity cases
inputs: sourced estimate inputs with units and dates
estimate specification with periods, assumptions and formulas

steps.what: Assess comparability, uncertainty and omitted project effects
Write the cost-benefit estimate with sources and limitations
inputs: sourced estimate inputs with units and dates

tasks.design: Use a native {SPREADSHEET} estimate template with explicit units, source dates and tested sensitivity formulas. A {DOCS} estimate format carries sources and table references while the technician retains valuation choices, comparability assessment and written limitations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rebuilding calculations and repeating source fields can consume estimate preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit input definitions and tested workbook formulas permit repeatable calculations without automatic investment decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Environmental effects and uncertain future benefits may not be comparable or monetisable.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what the estimate omits and which assumptions determine its result.
tasks.altitude: Focus estimating effort on defensible assumptions and uncertainty.

reach.learn: Provide scope, unit, date and uncertainty with quantities.

evidence.claim: Tested estimate workbooks and source headings could reduce repeated arithmetic and formatting; project valuation and time estimates are unmeasured.

assumptions: The boundary includes the written estimate, not only the judgement conversation. No new reporting or investment approval process is added.

The technician defines periods, scenarios and formulas in s1. Project engineers produce quantities and current reference owners produce cost rates; s2 includes retrieving, checking and entering values, units, price dates and provenance. Missing or incomparable evidence remains manual research and stops affected calculations.

Native input fields remove 3 hours of repeated source headings; the estimate document removes a different 3 hours of repeated table/reference formatting. Substantive valuation and limitations remain retained.
Existing automated calculations provide no new saving. Ordinary author saves remain within retained writing time without self-approval.
unknowns: How comparable cost and benefit references are between projects.
research_questions: Replay a completed municipal estimate with changed price dates and non-monetary benefits and measure total correction effort.

incremental.description: Maintain input definitions and tested estimate formulas

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=69, gross 31 minus 3 upkeep gives central net 28. Conservative case: weak cost comparability retains 24/25 input hours, bespoke scenarios retain 21/25 calculation hours and source-format mismatch retains 13/15 writing hours, plus 35 fixed: 93 retained, 7 gross minus 3 =4. A compatible recurring estimate retains 22 input, 10 calculation and 12 writing hours plus 35 fixed: 79 retained, 21 gross minus 3 =18.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate complaints about alterations to public waters

steps.what: Hear the complaints and clarify the disputed water alterations
Gather site evidence, permits and records concerning the water alteration
Assess the evidence and recommend defensible alternatives
Prepare the case's required legal documents and factual account
Check documents against evidence and current preparation requirements
Deliver the checked case response to the intended recipients

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} and {DATA_PLATFORM} case views to locate existing evidence, and authorised document headings for the legal preparation already required. The technician retains interviews, fact assessment, substantive document writing and checking, then controls the exact response sent through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding case records and repeating document identifiers can accompany a sensitive investigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Current case metadata and authorised formats can reduce navigation and repeated administrative text.
tasks.still_hard: Accounts may conflict and the alternatives have contested environmental and legal implications.
tasks.human_edge: Assess credibility and explain a defensible recommendation without treating a template as legal judgement.
tasks.altitude: Support the evidence trail while preserving accountable investigation.

reach.learn: Separate source evidence from contested assertions and recommendations.

evidence.claim: Native case views and authorised document headings could reduce clerical preparation; the investigation and legal substance remain manual and savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: The scenario includes the statement's legal document preparation where currently required and the real response handoff; it adds no separate activity log. Cases using only alternative recommendations have a different baseline.

Complainants produce their accounts in s1. Survey and permit owners produce existing dated site evidence, locations and permit versions; s2 includes retrieval and reconciliation. Missing records require manual investigation. The current process supplies an authorised document format; no new legal approval stage is invented.
The evidence view removes 3 hours of repeated navigation. The document format removes only 2.5 hours of repeated identifiers and headings, retaining all individual factual and legal wording.
No legal text generation, automated dispute finding or new external filing is proposed. Ordinary internal saves remain retained and ungated.
unknowns: Which case documents the technician actually prepares today.
Whether evidence locations and current document formats are consistently indexed.
research_questions: Replay a contested case and measure evidence search and heading entry separately from interviews and substantive preparation.

already_counted.description: Assess evidence and check the prepared documents

incremental.description: Maintain evidence links and authorised document headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact response text, attachments, case identity and recipients; changes require a fresh check before delivery.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=94.5, gross 5.5 minus 1 upkeep gives central net 4.5. Conservative case: poorly indexed evidence retains all 15 retrieval hours and a bespoke document retains 24/25 writing hours plus 60 fixed: 99 retained, 1 gross minus 1 =0. Compatible case identifiers retain 13 retrieval and 24 writing hours plus 60 fixed: 97 retained, 3 gross minus 1 =2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate glaciers, ice, snow and permafrost

steps.what: Define the glacier, ice, snow or permafrost investigation and measures
Investigate field conditions and capture identified observations
Assemble observations and compatible imagery with checked spatial metadata
Calculate specified spatial or temporal comparisons of the observed properties
outputs: comparison outputs with source and processing metadata

steps.what: Interpret the observed changes and limitations of the comparisons
inputs: comparison outputs with source and processing metadata

steps.what: Write the findings in the existing scientific investigation record
inputs: comparison outputs with source and processing metadata

tasks.design: Use existing {DATA_PLATFORM} spatial views to assemble identified observations and suitable imagery, then tested calculations for the specified comparisons. Field investigation, interpretation and the scientific findings record remain with the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating compatible imagery and repeating specified comparisons may require recurring manual preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Available corrected imagery and tested spatial calculations support repeatable analysis where dates and layers are compatible.
tasks.still_hard: Cloud, snow cover, resolution and changing site conditions can make comparisons misleading.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether an apparent change reflects the physical process being investigated.
tasks.altitude: Make repeated comparisons traceable while retaining field investigation and interpretation.

reach.learn: Preserve acquisition dates, resolution and coordinate definitions.

evidence.claim: Copernicus provides corrected Sentinel-2 imagery and mosaics; suitability for a particular ice or permafrost comparison still requires assessment.

assumptions: The baseline includes an existing scientific findings record used by the investigation team, not a newly introduced activity log. No saving is assigned to that writing.

The technician defines measures and comparison rules in s1 and captures observation location, date, value, unit and method in s2, with all field time retained. Imagery providers supply acquisition time, coordinate reference, resolution and processing metadata. S3 includes compatibility checks; missing or unsuitable layers return to manual preparation or stop the comparison.
Use native spatial views and established calculations first. The 3-hour s3 reduction removes repeated file discovery and metadata navigation, not field capture or scientific compatibility judgement.
No automatic change alert, new sensor collection or external publication is implied. Author saves remain fully retained and ungated.
unknowns: Whether imagery and field observations are compatible at the required dates and scale.
research_questions: Replay comparisons with cloud cover, changed resolution and missing coordinate metadata and measure total correction effort.

already_counted.description: Capture field evidence and interpret comparison validity

incremental.description: Maintain comparison tests and spatial metadata conventions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=82, gross 18 minus 2 upkeep gives central net 16. Conservative case: unsuitable layers retain all 20 assembly hours and bespoke processing retains 13/15 calculation hours plus 65 fixed: 98 retained, 2 gross minus 2 =0. Compatible acquisition dates and output metadata retain 18 assembly and 5 calculation hours plus 65 fixed: 88 retained, 12 gross minus 2 =10.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Locate and deliver requested hydrologic information

steps.what: Clarify the customer's requested information, location, period and format
Locate the requested information in current data and document views
Check relevance, completeness, currency and permission to disclose the information
Prepare the response package with source references and limitations
Deliver the checked information package to the customer

tasks.design: Configure native {DATA_PLATFORM} and {DOCS} catalogue filters for location, date and information type, then a response format carrying source references. The technician clarifies the request, checks disclosure and relevance, prepares the substantive response and controls the exact {EMAIL} delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated file search and response packaging can delay routine information requests.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing catalogue metadata and response formats can reduce navigation and repeated packaging.
tasks.still_hard: Information can be incomplete, unsuitable for the requested use or restricted.
tasks.human_edge: Explain limitations and recognise requests needing further investigation.
tasks.altitude: Make requested information easier to locate without automatic disclosure.

reach.learn: Separate discovery from relevance and disclosure checks.

evidence.claim: Native catalogue filters and response formats could reduce repeated search and packaging; no measured time saving or automatic disclosure capability is asserted.

assumptions: The task includes preparing and actually delivering the information, with no added trailing case log.

The customer supplies location, requested period, subject, format and recipient details, clarified by the technician in s1 with full time retained. Existing data and document owners maintain catalogue identifiers, dates and access metadata; s2/s3 include checking these. Missing metadata require manual search and disclosure assessment.

The search reduction removes repeated catalogue navigation and filtering. The separate 4.5-hour response reduction removes repeated headings, source-list formatting and attachment packaging; customer-specific interpretation stays retained.
Native search and formats precede custom retrieval. No autonomous answers or sends are proposed; ordinary internal saves remain retained without self-approval.
unknowns: Catalogue completeness and native filter availability.
How much response packaging is genuinely repeated today.
research_questions: Compare current requests with native filters, including missing metadata and restricted information, and measure total review time.

already_counted.description: Assess relevance and disclosure before preparing a response

incremental.description: Maintain catalogue views and response formatting

approvals.approved_version: Exact response wording, attached datasets, source versions and customer recipient; any changed package or recipient requires checking again before delivery.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=78, gross 22 minus 2 upkeep gives central net 20. Conservative case: weak catalogue coverage retains 31/35 search hours and bespoke output metadata retain 14/15 packaging hours plus 50 fixed: 95 retained, 5 gross minus 2 =3. With usable location/date filters and compatible output format, retain 23 search and 12 packaging hours plus 50 fixed: 85 retained, 15 gross minus 2 =13.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain field, valuation and public-facing judgement while making calculations and information preparation reproducible.
reach: Agree source metadata with project engineers, data owners and environmental colleagues.
role.ambitious_version: Traceable hydrologic advice and information with specific, demonstrable clerical reductions.
